article_type: Methods/metaresearch article; final category subject to journal verification.
target_journals: Journal of the Medical Library Association
core_contribution: How often are published searches reconstructable, and how much retrieval and downstream variation is attributable to missing or ambiguous reporting?
required_tables: Primary outcomes with denominator, uncertainty and missingness
Error taxonomy, unsupported cases and negative results
required_figures: Workflow with explicit ownership and evidence boundaries
Paired or stratified primary-effect display with uncertainty
required_supplements: Permitted source/record inventories or reference-only manifests
Claim-to-output map and independent replay instructions
permitted_claims_after_evidence: Only the preregistered capability/domain-specific findings supported by executed results.
Distinguish internal conformance from real consumer, live source and independent methodological evidence.
prohibited_claims: A checksum is an authenticity proof
Internal agent review is independent external validation
reporting_profiles: STROBE-informed cross-sectional reporting where applicable; not a claim of a prescribed checklist for every design
authorship_policy: Use accountable human authors and contribution statements; agree roles prospectively, retain conflicts and AI/tool disclosures; no guaranteed or honorary authorship.
overlap_policy: One primary methods paper per genuinely distinct question. Reused corpora/methods are cited and overlapping analyses disclosed; combine studies rather than split minimally different results.
release_policy: Every table, figure and numerical claim links to a protocol version, dataset revision, run and result artifact. A new analysis changes the result revision and regenerates dependent manuscript objects. Publication/submission needs explicit human approval.
